usb_bridge_probe.reference_correction: Pinned FNHRRemote::Update sends RF packets every 20ms, including idle echo. The remote does have periodic traffic; stock robot UpdateRF24 ignores echo instead of using it for link-loss expiry. Manual remote preservation need not be ruled out merely for lack of periodic traffic.
